method: source inspection and read-only installed SDK signature checks

findings.finding: Renderer is called with an unsupported device keyword; detach_ovstage is called with an unsupported stage argument.
Stage.population and Stage.PathDictionary do not exist in the installed pinned SDK.
Model construction omits collision shapes and authored body transforms, uses nonexistent newton.SolverXPBD, and publishes an empty transform matrix array.
The requested render product is never authored; the camera lacks orientation toward the workspace.
Inspector fields are noneditable list entries; worker does not handle save or save-as commands; hierarchy is hardcoded rather than derived from the loaded stage.
Settings displays an informational message instead of an editable settings dialog and LLM configuration controls.
Required native and UI behavior tests are unconditional failure placeholders, not implemented tests.
The exact generation request contains the native API requirements and complete settings requirements; input truncation does not explain these omissions.
